title: D. A wall three protofilaments wide

provenance.note: Coordinates are RCSB biological assembly 1 of entry 5SYF, restricted to six of its 26 deposited helical operators: three neighboring protofilaments at 166.20, 138.50 and 110.80 degrees, each two tubulin dimers deep. No coordinate was altered.

chapters.title: Three wide
chapters.caption: Blue alpha, amber beta: six 5SYF dimers, three strands. Grow steps show measured pieces, not recorded assembly.

immersive.narration: Blue alpha, amber beta. Steps show measured pieces, not recorded assembly.
